## Activity

During October 2021, River Outreach recorded 43 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and establishes the volume submitted for image review and grading. The recorded captures should be retained in the site activity record for routine monitoring and comparison with subsequent reports.

## Image quality

Of the submitted captures, 7 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 16.3. These results should be reviewed as part of the site’s routine quality monitoring. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related concerns can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate process.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. These results should be managed through the established follow-up process, with the referable findings clearly recorded and monitored. Activity, image quality and grading information should continue to be reviewed together to support operational oversight at River Outreach.
